name: LeverageUsingSiloFlashloanWithGeneralSwap unvalidated swap target
summary: openLeveragePosition() on the unreleased leverage helper accepted a caller-supplied flashloan target and swap calldata without constraining them to the selected Silo market, so a fake flash lender's onFlashLoan callback made the helper call the real WETH Silo's borrow() on behalf of a third party that had granted it debt-receive approval.
notes: The direct leverage-helper runtime was deployed in this transaction and is byte-identical immediately before the incident.
The exploit receipt records exactly 224 WETH transferred from Silo 0x160287e2d3fdcde9e91317982fc1cc01c1f94085 to the attacker EOA while debt shares were assigned to the approved third-party borrower.
